description: Approximate landmark registration of the cropped castle artwork. 1F uses trial-door landmarks; upper floors align their central tower rooms in one game-coordinate frame. Stair illustrations are schematic, not a surveyed top-down projection.
notes: 1F origin for game (0,0) is image (935,1168). The four main trial doors align at approximately (806,1230), (1064,769), (806,769), (1064,1231).
2F through 6F pivots use the central room silhouette. 7F uses the stairwell axis inferred from its landing layout; its boss-door placement requires visual review in game.
All images remain at the same source scale. No per-floor resize-to-fit is allowed.
